title: Master of Public Policy
institution: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU), College of Public Policy
about: Hamad Bin Khalifa University's College of Public Policy in Doha invites applications to its Master of Public Policy. Applicants from all fields may apply, with preference for social-science backgrounds; international applicants apply online by 1 February 2027.
requirements: Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record (minimum 3.0 GPA out of 4.0) from a recognized university
IELTS score of 6.5 or TOEFL score of 79, unless exempt
Official electronic copies of transcripts with the online application

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI II
why: Field "Public policy" → "Government & public sector: policy analysis, public service automation, defence AI"
